plan.reason: Only 24/100 evaluations used but stagnation is high (20) with zero recent improvement, indicating the current reference design is exploiting too narrowly. Auto surrogate lets held-out RMSE pick RBF vs quadratic for a 5D problem with limited data. Keep current_to_best (good balance of convergence and diversity), but modestly lower mutation/crossover toward robust exploration and raise exploration to 0.45 so the novelty-distance term pushes candidates away from repeatedly sampled regions; local fraction stays moderate (0.35) to retain local refinement within the 0.12 normalized radius. Population 30 with 6 generations balances surrogate retraining cost under the fixed budget without requesting extra true evaluations.
